description: OQ4 (line 181) lists 'child boot on Akash — exact SDL + cloud-init that installs the automaton + wallet + ClawRouter env' as an unresolved open question. On disk this is already substantially built: deploy-akash.sh:42-73 contains a complete SDL (version 2.0, automaton service, compute profile, placement pricing, deployment) plus the full lease flow (deployment create -> poll bids -> lease create -> wait active -> send-manifest), and cloud-init.sh supplies the ClawRouter+automaton env. The open-question section therefore misrepresents project state (presents built work as unknown). Conversely, the ACTUAL unresolved gap — automated on-chain USDC seed transfer to the child wallet — is NOT captured as an open question anywhere; run.sh:196 merely prints a human instruction ('Seed the child wallet with $X and it wakes on its own'). The load-bearing unknown is hidden while a solved item is flagged unknown.
